trigger: user-requested early fire to check SnapKV impact
dedup_rationale: SnapKV and ShadowKV code landed (commits 4b09927, 09461df, f4e7f49, 2276284) but NONE of it is wired into the default duo bench path. The bench still runs --kv-mode duo without SnapKV. Results are R59-equivalent moderate co-tenancy (load 4.15, warmup 8.9s, swap 6.0 GB). Quality byte-identical for 8th consecutive run. No breakthrough — just reproducibility under mild pressure.

commits: 4b09927 feat: SnapKV attention-guided token selection — needle preserved at 25%
09461df test: 13 new SnapKV source + validation tests — 204 total passing
snapkv_assessment.why_not_visible_in_this_run: The bench runs .venv/bin/python -m omlx.bench.hypercar_bench --full which defaults to --kv-mode duo. SnapKV is a separate module (likely omlx/snapkv.py or similar) that needs to be integrated as a new --kv-mode option or as a post-prefill eviction step within the existing duo path. Until it's wired in, the bench measures the same cache behavior as R44 onward.
snapkv_assessment.what_the_commit_says: 'needle preserved at 25%' means SnapKV kept only 25% of KV entries while still finding the needle in NIAH. That's 4x effective compression — extremely promising for Goal 1 (1M context) and Goal 3 (decode speed). But the bench doesn't exercise it yet.
snapkv_assessment.recommendation: To measure SnapKV's impact, either: (a) add --kv-mode snapkv or --kv-eviction snapkv flag and run the bench with it, or (b) wire SnapKV as the default post-prefill step in duo mode and let the next analyst run capture the delta automatically. The analyst cron will detect the change when it appears in the log lines.

memory.swap_peak_note: Back up to 6.0 GB from R62's 0.0. Co-tenancy pressure returned (load 4.15, warmup 8.9s). Not a regression — swap was 0.0 two hours ago on a cleaner box.

smoke_decode_note: First time below 50 tok/s in the session (R61 was 53.9). Borderline Goal 3 miss at short context due to co-tenancy. Warmup 8.9s confirms pressure regime.
